verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Probes also confirm .md versions of doc pages that point agents to the llms.txt index, plus a machine-readable openapi.json. Many docs pages are cited in .md form, and the CLI and Agent API are documented for agent use, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or explicit first-party docs page describing the agent-docs offering, and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
